accepted_by: product decision — not a linguistic decision
reason: Current Kurdish user base is small; localization is being shipped provisionally and will be refined through future native review and user feedback.
what_this_status_means: The Kurdish corpus is technically complete and passes every automated guarantee.
It is acceptable to ship at the current product stage.
Native linguistic review remains an open, optional quality-improvement task.
what_this_status_does_NOT_mean: No Sorani speaker has read any of these 523 strings.
native_approved_count is 0 and must stay 0 until a named human reviewer approves keys individually in review-queue.json.

future_review_priority.scope: checkout and delivery, errors, order statuses, loyalty and rewards, login gates, long sentences, strings mirroring backend notification text
product UI, settings, account, search and filters, counters

known_followups: rewardClaimedDiscount — backend notification says خاڵەکەت (point) where the glossary locks خەڵات (reward); backend-side fix, out of scope here
promoBadge — داشکاندن is shown precisely when no discount percentage exists; alternative تایبەت needs a product/glossary decision covering the offers section title too
cancel — پاشگەزبوونەوە is glossary-locked and passes the responsive matrix; shorter وازهێنان only if a real usability problem is demonstrated
genderPickerNote — the note promises gendered address that Sorani does not inflect; product decision, no artificial Kurdish gender variants invented
search chips — chip text doubles as the search query; Kurdish matching depends on backend name_ckb and cannot be verified locally, needs integration QA

genderMale/genderFemale — نێر/مێ are option nouns and must stay distinct (a picker with two identical labels is unusable); conjugated address stays one Kurdish form. Native reviewer to confirm مێ vs مێینە for a formal UI.

2026-09-12 audit — Kurdish now also flows through: backend error messages (domain/errorMessages.ts, ~80), the 7 loyalty level names, category/subcategory/option/governorate/zone/product content (migration 047 + seed). All AI-drafted, none native-reviewed; they live outside review-queue.json and need the same review pass.

2026-09-12 admin-managed accounts — 18 keys for the registration/forgot-password request flow (account_pending_screen, forgot_password_screen). The OTP-era keys sendCodeShort/enterPhoneForReset/… stay in the corpus unused until a cleanup pass; the screens that used them are in legacy/otp/.
